name: Ryou
source:
"Hee, adults are amazing!"

A cheerful idiot who is curious about H things. He goes out of his way to go to the candy shop and read the erotic books he's picked up. For a 4th grader, he has a lot of erotic knowledge. However, since the source of his information are erotic novels, most of it is incorrect.

Their physical contact is so intense that it distorts the protagonist's propensity. It may have to do with the lonely expression he suddenly showed...

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/aki01251/status/1590501899182432256]official bio[/url]]
